# dsh-agent-flight-recorder

Live runtime health for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agents.
It watches tool calls as they happen and tell

s **you** (panel) and **the model** (short notices)
when the agent is going round in circles.
> **Maintenance:** best-effort. Issues may go unanswered; forks are welcome.
## What it does

- **Loop detection** over the last 100 tool calls: the same tool called many times in a row
(even wi

th slightly different arguments, which defeats identical-call detectors), the same
error coming back

, a high error rate.
- **`runtime_health` tool** the model can call when it suspects it is stuck: co

unts, error rate,
average latency, most used tool, a status (`healthy` / `warning` / `critical`), a

`loopRisk`
estimate in 0..1, reasons and a recommendation.
- **Live alerts**: a ~40-token notice add

ed to the tool result when a threshold is crossed.
- **Per-turn summary** sent to the model after ea

ch turn (about 20 tokens when healthy).
- **Web UI**: a *Runtime Health* chip under the composer tha

t opens a panel, a one-line summary
under every completed turn, and a detailed conversation report (

tokens, tools, "points to verify"
such as a file written to an unexpected path, or sources cited wit

hout any search).
- English and French UI.

It only observes and annotates: no network, no shell, no file writes, no blocking.
All state is deri

ved from the durable session log, so it survives page reloads and disappears when
the plugin is remo
ved. See SPEC.md for the rules and the `loopRisk` formula.
## Install

Restart the profile afterwards. Requires Node `^22.19.0 || >=24` and DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0` (see
file afterwards. Requires Node `^22.19.0 || >=24` and DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0` (see Compatibility).

Optional companion: `@beibeihk/dsh-agent-observability`
(durable per-session recorder, `/observe` re
port). This plugin does not depend on it.
## Configuration
Row `agent-flight-recorder` in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`; every key is optional.
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `windowSize` | 100 | tool calls kept for the rules |
| `sameToolWarning` / `sameToolCritical` | 4

/ 6 | consecutive calls of one tool |
| `sameErrorWarning` / `sameErrorCritical` | 2 / 3 | same norm

alized error repeated |
| `errorRateWarning` / `errorRateCritical` | 0.2 / 0.3 | error rate (after `

errorRateMinCalls`, default 10) |
| `shellTools` | `[bash, pwsh]` | tools treated as shell commands

|
| `turnSummaryToModel` | true | send the per-turn summary to the model |
| `liveAlerts` | true | a
dd alerts to tool results |
## Compatibility
| Component | Supported |
ptional `peerDependencies` on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` (`>=3.18.0 <4.0.0

`) and `zod` (`>=4.0.0 <5.0.0`), the packages the plugin loads from the DSH installation |
| Platfor
m | Linux (tested); pure JavaScript, no native addon |
Tested with DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` on Node 22.23 (see Verification).
## Permissions and external services
| Capability | Used? | Detail |
| Files | no | nothing is read from or written to disk by the plugin itself; its state lives in the

DSH session log |
| Network | no | no request of any kind |
| Commands | no | no process is started

|
| Dynamic module loading | yes | `index.js` (`importFromDsh`) loads `zod`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools
` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` from the DSH installation that runs the plugin (a synchronous `requ
ire` of an ES module fails on Node 22). Nothing is downloaded and no code is evaluated from text (`e
val` / `new Function` are not used). The plugin fails to load if DSH does not provide them |
It adds one read-only tool (`runtime_health`) and, when `liveAlerts` is on, appends short alerts to
tool results. It never blocks or modifies a tool call.
